principles: A successful deployment is not proof of every user-visible path.
A claim status does not improve merely because it is repeated.
Each important claim retains scope, uncertainty, source and a revalidation path.

GitHub Actions run #39 completed successfully; JS syntax checks, domain/security contract tests, and JSON validation passed.
